lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਨਖ ਸਿਖ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਚੀਨੑਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab nakh sikh ihu man cheenhaa ||
lines.translation: When I came to understand this mind, from the tips of my toes to the crown of my head,
then I took my cleansing bath, deep within my self. ||1||
The mind, the master of the breath, abides in the state of supreme bliss.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਹੀ ਮਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: nahee mirat na janam jaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: There is no death, no re-birth, and no aging for me now. ||1||Pause||
Turning away from materialism, I have found intuitive support.
I have entered into the sky of the mind, and opened the Tenth Gate.
The chakras of the coiled Kundalini energy have been opened,
and I have met my Sovereign Lord King without fear. ||2||
My attachment to Maya has been eradicated;
the moon energy has devoured the sun energy.
When I was focused and merged into the all-pervading Lord,
then the unstruck sound current began to vibrate. ||3||
The Speaker has spoken, and proclaimed the Word of the Shabad.
The hearer has heard, and enshrined it in the mind.
Chanting to the Creator, one crosses over.
Says Kabeer, this is the essence. ||4||1||10||
The moon and the sun are both the embodiment of light.
Within their light, is God, the incomparable. ||1||
O spiritual teacher, contemplate God.
In this light is contained the expanse of the created universe. ||1||Pause||
Gazing upon the diamond, I humbly salute this diamond.
Says Kabeer, the Immaculate Lord is indescribable. ||2||2||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਹੁਸੀਆਰ ਬੇਦਾਰ ਜਾਗਤ ਮੁਸੀਅਤ ਹਉ ਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: duneeaa huseeaar bedaar jaagat museeat hau re bhaaee ||
lines.translation: People of the world, remain awake and aware. Even though you are awake, you are being robbed, O Siblings of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਗਮ ਹੁਸੀਆਰ ਪਹਰੂਆ ਦੇਖਤ ਜਮੁ ਲੇ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: nigam huseeaar paharooaa dekhat jam le jaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: While the Vedas stand guard watching, the Messenger of Death carries you away. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੀੰਬੁ ਭਇਓ ਆਂਬੁ ਆਂਬੁ ਭਇਓ ਨੀੰਬਾ ਕੇਲਾ ਪਾਕਾ ਝਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: nee(n)b bhaio aa(n)b aa(n)b bhaio nee(n)baa kelaa paakaa jhaar ||
lines.translation: He thinks that the bitter nimm fruit is a mango, and the mango is a bitter nimm. He imagines the ripe banana on the thorny bush.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਲੀਏਰ ਫਲੁ ਸੇਬਰਿ ਪਾਕਾ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naaleeer phal sebar paakaa moorakh mugadh gavaar ||1||
lines.translation: He thinks that the ripe coconut hangs on the barren simmal tree; what a stupid, idiotic fool he is! ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਇਓ ਖਾਂਡੁ ਰੇਤੁ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਖਰਿਓ ਹਸਤੀੰ ਚੁਨਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har bhaio khaa(n)d ret mahi bikhario hasatee(n) chunio na jaaee ||
lines.translation: The Lord is like sugar, spilled onto the sand; the elephant cannot pick it up.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਮੀਰ ਕੁਲ ਜਾਤਿ ਪਾਂਤਿ ਤਜਿ ਚੀਟੀ ਹੋਇ ਚੁਨਿ ਖਾਈ ॥੨॥੩॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: kahi kameer kul jaat paa(n)t taj cheetee hoi chun khaaee ||2||3||12||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, give up your ancestry, social status and honor; be like the tiny ant - pick up and eat the sugar. ||2||3||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: baanee naamadeu jeeu kee raamakalee ghar 1 ||
lines.translation: The Word Of Naam Dayv Jee, Raamkalee, First House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਨੀਲੇ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਕਾਟੀਲੇ ਗੂਡੀ ਆਕਾਸ ਮਧੇ ਭਰਮੀਅਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aaneele kaagad kaateele goodee aakaas madhe bharameeale ||
lines.translation: The boy takes paper, cuts it and makes a kite, and flies it in the sky.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਜਨਾ ਸਿਉ ਬਾਤ ਬਤਊਆ ਚੀਤੁ ਸੁ ਡੋਰੀ ਰਾਖੀਅਲੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch janaa siu baat bataooaa cheet s doree raakheeale ||1||
lines.translation: Talking with his friends, he still keeps his attention on the kite string. ||1||
My mind has been pierced by the Name of the Lord,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਕਨਿਕ ਕਲਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਮਾਂਡੀਅਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaise kanik kalaa chit maa(n)deeale ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: like the goldsmith, whose attention is held by his work. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਨੀਲੇ ਕੁੰਭੁ ਭਰਾਈਲੇ ਊਦਕ ਰਾਜ ਕੁਆਰਿ ਪੁਰੰਦਰੀਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: aaneele ku(n)bh bharaaeele oodak raaj kuaar pura(n)dareee ||
lines.translation: The young girl in the city takes a pitcher, and fills it with water.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਸਤ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਬੀਚਾਰ ਕਰਤੀ ਹੈ ਚੀਤੁ ਸੁ ਗਾਗਰਿ ਰਾਖੀਅਲੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: hasat binod beechaar karatee hai cheet s gaagar raakheeale ||2||
lines.translation: She laughs, and plays, and talks with her friends, but she keeps her attention focused on the pitcher of water. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੰਦਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਦੁਆਰ ਦਸ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਗਊ ਚਰਾਵਨ ਛਾਡੀਅਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ma(n)dar ek duaar das jaa ke gaoo charaavan chhaadeeale ||
lines.translation: The cow is let loose, out of the mansion of the ten gates, to graze in the field.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਂਚ ਕੋਸ ਪਰ ਗਊ ਚਰਾਵਤ ਚੀਤੁ ਸੁ ਬਛਰਾ ਰਾਖੀਅਲੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: paa(n)ch kos par gaoo charaavat cheet s bachharaa raakheeale ||3||
lines.translation: It grazes up to five miles away, but keeps its attention focused on its calf. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਤਿਲੋਚਨ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਪਾਲਨ ਪਉਢੀਅਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahat naamadeu sunahu tilochan baalak paalan paudheeale ||
lines.translation: Says Naam Dayv, listen, O Trilochan: the child is laid down in the cradle.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਾਜ ਬਿਰੂਧੀ ਚੀਤੁ ਸੁ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਰਾਖੀਅਲੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar baahar kaaj biroodhee cheet s baarik raakheeale ||4||1||
lines.translation: Its mother is at work, inside and outside, but she holds her child in her thoughts. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਆਨੰਤਾ ਗੀਤ ਕਬਿਤ ਨ ਗਾਵਉਗੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: bed puraan saasatr aana(n)taa geet kabit na gaavaugo ||
lines.translation: There are countless Vedas, Puraanas and Shaastras; I do not sing their songs and hymns.
